pieces.Text: As a product of generations spent in low- or zero-gravity environments, some halflings have elongated skeletons and stand a full head taller than others of their species. These halflings can be mistaken for humans of short stature, but they still exhibit the enlarged feet and hands and the pointed ears characteristic of halflings. Halflings who have this racial trait take no penalty to Disguise checks when attempting to appear human or Medium in size. This replaces keen senses.
